adoption: All twelve independently written outcomes and exact stored documents match predicted failure IDs
Both duplicate insertion and suppression of a distinct request rejected, with valid facts/qualifiers preserved
Missing effect evidence returns no partial observations
Identical source reads and <=1024 extra valid-response bytes
Only sequential synthetic storage; no network/crash/concurrency, performance, cost or reasoning-quality claim
common_guard: All variants reject reuse of an existing request ID with a different payload
fault_model: At most one retry per operation; injection before invocation or after its closed storage/accepted result, with a fresh TinyDB object for every invocation
